sources.role: Authoritative source for targets. Contains dataset URLs but no code link.

Selected for the Sign Language MNIST targets. The notebook outputs and all checkpoints differ, i.e. the paper's first author re-ran the tutorial. The tutorial covers Sign Language MNIST only; neither it nor the article mentions the second dataset, a classification report, or a confusion matrix. Its committed checkpoint was evaluated as supplementary evidence (run mnist-article-checkpoint).
Checkpoint the upstream README names as the best model. Evaluated as supplementary evidence only; target values come from retraining.

status.numerical_agreement_basis: Criterion fixed before the notebook runs finished: a produced target agrees when the reproduced value, rounded to the paper's reported precision (two decimals for precision/recall/F1, whole percent for accuracy), equals the published value; the overall status is 'agrees' only if every produced in-scope target agrees. Assessed scope: the 85 Sign Language MNIST targets (Table 3.1 and the accuracy stated with Fig. 3.4) from the primary run. 23 of 85 agree. The 121 American Sign Language Dataset targets were not produced and are not assessed.
status.preference_level_basis: Sign Language MNIST: the pinned upstream notebook is executed unmodified (level 1); only an evaluation script is added, because upstream computes accuracy but not the per-class report.
